engine_cli_scoring_filters._doc: backtest/lib/filters.py evaluate_bearish_setup / evaluate_bullish_setup, called via engine_cli.decide_payload -> score_bar. Both sides scored every tick; engine_cli._derive_routing picks the winner (bear wins ties).

filters.name: VIX > 17.30 AND vix_rising (vix_soft_mode: -1 score demerit instead of hard block when flag set, default off)
breakdown_bar_bearish on last closed bar (f9_vol_mult configurable)
>= min_triggers of {level_reject / ribbon_flip / multi_day_confluence / sequence_rejection} + at least one level-tied trigger

SWEEP_BLOCKER: block if a BULLISH_SWEEP (down-sweep, price wicked below rejection_level then closed back above) detected in prior sweep_block_window_bars bars; HARD block, not bypassable by allow_one_blocker; confluence carve-out skips it. sweep_blocker_enabled default False.
time gates (>= 10:00 ET in doc / >=09:35 in code default, NOT in 14:00-15:00 window)
VIX < 17.20 OR vix_falling (vix_soft_mode_bull: -1 demerit instead of hard block, default False, NOT wired into heartbeat_core.py per that flag's own docstring)
buyer pressure: close>open AND vol >= 0.7x 20-bar avg (f10_vol_mult configurable, RATIFIED v11)
>= min_triggers of {level_reclaim / ribbon_flip / multi_day_confluence / sequence_reclaim} AND htf_15m != BEAR (-1 score modifier if BEAR, not a hard block)

SWEEP_BLOCKER: block if a BEARISH_SWEEP (up-sweep, price wicked above reclaim_level then closed back below) detected in prior sweep_block_window_bars bars; HARD block; confluence carve-out skips it. sweep_blocker_enabled default False.

sig_safe.source_row: the SAFE core-decisions.jsonl row (account=='safe'), production-faithful: passed = (action == 'ENTER_BEAR'/'ENTER_BULL') literally.

sig_bold.source_row: the BOLD core-decisions.jsonl row (account=='bold'), via _bold_passed_blocks_from_row (lines 583-627): passed = _score_peak_check(side, action, score, trigger, fired) AND action not in _HARD_SKIP_VERDICTS ({'SKIP_BULLISH_FILL_BAR_AT_BEAR_ENTRY'}). _score_peak_check passes when score >= peak threshold (bull 9/11, bear 8/10, BULL_PEAK_THRESHOLD/BEAR_PEAK_THRESHOLD lines 850-851) with a fired trigger -- NOT a literal action=='ENTER_BULL' string match, and NOT gated on any of safe's GATE_KEYS.

sig_strategies.both_pass: condition true regardless of WHICH side bold passed (only checks .get('passed') is True on either); s_bear AND s_bull are BOTH swapped to bold's dicts together (a non-empty dict is truthy so 'bold.get(x) or y' always takes bold's dict when present) -- there is no per-side split.
sig_strategies.only_bold_passes_one_side: same as above: BOTH s_bear and s_bull come from bold's blocks even if only bold's bull (say) passed; bold's own bear dict inside that swap still carries passed=False so the bear side stays not-fired, but the SOURCE ledger for both sides is now bold's, not safe's.
sig_strategies.neither_bold_side_passes: condition false -> s_bear/s_bull remain safe's production-faithful (bear, bull) dicts unchanged.
sig_strategies.safe_passes_bold_does_not: irrelevant to selection -- only bold's pass state gates the swap; if bold does not pass either side, strategies[] is built off safe regardless of what safe did (which in this scenario is a normal ENTER, so no divergence).

build_function_construction.ribbon_strategy_entries: _ribbon_strategy_entries (line 484): one entry per side where blk.get('passed') is True, name='ribbon_ride', quality ELITE if confluence/sequence trigger present else BASE.

plan_from_strategies.mechanism: iterates signal.get('strategies') or [] directly -- the SAME list for every arm, regardless of arm id/role. Applies ONLY: strategies.by_name(entry.name) lookup (skip unknown), _gate_block_for_entry (synthesizes a passed=True side-block from the entry), _gate_check(arm, blk, signal) (arm's OWN selectivity: min_triggers / require_confluence_or_sequence / min_setup_quality -- reads arm.get('gate_override'), no safe/bold role logic anywhere in this function), per-setup strike routing (STRATEGY_STRIKE_TIERS override for vwap_reclaim_failed_break only), sizing tiers, recency/full-send min-sizing clamps. NEVER reads signal['safe'], signal['bold'], signal['bear'], or signal['bull']; never calls _perception_for_arm.

reads: arm.gate_override.require_confluence_or_sequence (via _is_elite: confluence flag OR a sequence_* trigger)

sequence: 2. min_entry_premium floor (params['min_entry_premium'], per-arm base params file) -- SKIP_MIN_PREMIUM_FLOOR if premium below floor. Runs BEFORE risk_gate, not a risk_gate rule.

3. _fleet_params['pdt_gate_mode'] forced to 'margin_pdt' regardless of what the arm's base params file says (BLAST-RADIUS GUARD, prevents fleet arms from inheriting core's cash_settlement mode, which they don't compute inputs for).
4. cheap_contract_qty_boost (risky-3 only, params_patch-driven) -- raises qty if premium < threshold, never shrinks.

5. tight-ladder per-entry caps: max_contracts_per_entry / max_position_dollars (risk_gate.cap_entry_qty) -- MAX_POSITION_CONFLICT HOLD if a deadlock; else notes the cap in reason string (e.g. safe-3's '8->5' cap seen live 2026-09-03).
6. _shrink_qty_to_affordable (SHRINK-NOT-DENY, pct-of-equity RISK_CAP-aware shrink, independent of step 5's cap).

7. FLEET SETTLEMENT GATE (fleet_settlement_gate_enabled=true in BOTH params files as of 2026-08-18): risk_gate.check_settlement directly -- settled cash + max_same_day_roundtrips (=4 since 2026-08-29, was 5) -- independent of pdt_gate_mode; only runs if settled_cash_available is supplied (fleet_live.run() supplies it per-arm; run_dry()/tests do not).

8. risk_gate.check_order -- kill switch (Rule 5), per-trade risk cap (Rule 6), PDT/legacy margin check (Rule 7, margin_pdt mode per step 3 -- day_trades_used_5d read but FINRA repealed this constraint 2026-06-04 per params.json's own doc), NOT_FLAT/no-add (Rule 4), first_entry_after_stop_blocked.

9. Rescue lanes if still no ENTER: probe (risky-3 only, arm_id-gated), score ladder (gate_override.score_ladder_floor -- none of the 6 arms currently carry this key live, all disarmed per their score_ladder_doc fields), full_send (gate_override.full_send -- risky-1 only).
